value.rationale: Defines and solves the natural finite-budget RR-vs-IID reliability question on minimal two-component strongly convex-concave games. The exact cone/step classification proves arbitrarily-small-step failure and restored all-direction dominance at larger admissible steps in one fixed problem with strictly contractive updates. This is more informative than a routine counterexample or a general asymptotic rate comparison.
